arxiv-2104-07467.creator: Momchil Hardalov, Arnav Arora, Preslav Nakov, Isabelle Augenstein
arxiv-2104-07467.description: Abstract Stance detection concerns the classification of a writer’s viewpoint towards a target. There are different task variants, e.g., stance of a tweet vs. a full article, or stance with respect to a claim vs. an (implicit) topic. Moreover, task definitions vary, which includes the label inventory, the data collection, and the annotation protocol.

arxiv-2207-10777.description: Abstract Fully Automatic License Plate Recognition (ALPR) has been a frequent research topic due to several practical applications. However, many of the current solutions are still not robust enough in real situations, commonly depending on many constraints. This paper presents a robust and efficient ALPR system based on the state-of-the-art YOLO object detector and Normalizing flows.

pmc-10550753.creator: Arash Sharafat Vaziri, Ghazaleh Moradkhani, Morad Karimpour, Mohammad Naghi Tahmasebi, Soodabeh Esfandiary, Fardis Vosoughi, Seyedeh Reihaneh Hosseini
pmc-10550753.description: The use of customized 3D-printed structures has been gaining popularity in non-union management, as it allows for bypassing the defect while promoting osseointegration. Additionally, porous titanium implants minimize stress shielding due to their stiffness and elastic modulus being closer to that of bone. The interconnected channels increase the surface area and provide space for cell adhesion and proliferation.

pmc-10741861.title: Advancements in Wearable EEG Technology for Improved Home-Based Sleep Monitoring and Assessment: A Review
pmc-10741861.creator: Manal Mohamed, Nourelhuda Mohamed, Jae Gwan Kim
pmc-10741861.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Sleep is a fundamental aspect of daily life, profoundly impacting mental and emotional well-being. Optimal sleep quality is vital for overall health and quality of life, yet many individuals struggle with sleep-related difficulties. In the past, polysomnography (PSG) has served as the gold standard for assessing sleep, but its bulky nature, cost, and the need for expertise has made it cumbersome for widespread use. By recognizing the need for a more accessible and user-friendly approach, wearable home monitoring systems have emerged.

pmc-11510895.description: Background/Objectives: Electrochemotherapy (ECT) is a safe and efficient method of targeted drug delivery using pulsed electric fields (PEF), one that is based on the phenomenon of electroporation. However, the problems of electric field homogeneity within a tumor can cause a diminishing of the treatment efficacy, resulting only in partial response to the procedure.

pmc-11633369.title: The SINA1‐BSD1 Module Regulates Vegetative Growth Involving Gibberellin Biosynthesis in Tomato
pmc-11633369.creator: Yulin Yuan, Youhong Fan, Li Huang, Han Lu, Bowen Tan, Chloe Ramirez, Chao Xia, Xiangli Niu, Sixue Chen, Mingjun Gao, Cankui Zhang, Yongsheng Liu, Fangming Xiao
pmc-11633369.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). In plants, vegetative growth is controlled by synergistic and/or antagonistic effects of many regulatory factors. Here, the authors demonstrate that the ubiquitin ligase seven in absentia1 (SINA1) mammalian BTF2‐like transcription factors, Drosophila synapse‐associated proteins, and yeast DOS2‐like proteins (BSD1) function as a regulatory module to control vegetative growth in tomato via regulation of the production of plant growth hormone gibberellin (GA).

pmc-11645988.title: P115 Towards the Perfect Mattress: influence of age on soft tissue pressure
pmc-11645988.creator: L Rayward, G Kerr, M Pearcy, P Little
pmc-11645988.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). IntroductionLittle is known about the relationship between mattress mechanics and sleep comfort in healthy people. Excessively firm mattresses increase arousal frequency, suggesting that control of soft tissue pressures and spinal distortion plays a role in improving sleep quality.MethodsThis study presents findings from a parametric finite element (FE) analysis to investigate influence of age, anthropometry, mattress stiffness and mattress technology on soft tissue pressure in the pelvis area during supine lying.

pmc-11678676.title: Novel Deposition Technique for Fabricating Films with Customized Thickness Profiles
pmc-11678676.creator: Chi-Yung Hsieh, Yu-Chi Lin, Xuan-Shan Huang, Jing-Ting Lin, Cheng-Sheng Huang
pmc-11678676.description: This study introduces a novel deposition technique capable of depositing thin films with any arbitrary thickness profile. The apparatus consists of a fixed shadow mask and a rotating sample carrier plate. The shadow mask features a specifically designed opening curve that corresponds to the particular thickness profile of the deposited film.

pmc-12608801.title: Detecting Escherichia coli Contamination on Plant Leaf Surfaces Using UV-C Fluorescence Imaging and Deep Learning

This study evaluated the performance of the CSI-D+ system combined with deep learning for detecting varying concentrations of E.
